name: Direction set at 10:00, then a new day extreme — trending tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: Continuation: a fresh high (low) after the morning confirms buyers (sellers) are still in control. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_first.md). Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).

scan.when: (!rollwin && abs(at(10,0) - open) > 0.25 * atr && ((sign(at(10,0) - open) > 0 && cl(5,1) > lag(5, hi_since(9,30))) || (sign(at(10,0) - open) < 0 && cl(5,1) < lag(5, lo_since(9,30))))) && acr(rt, 30) > 0
